title: Why Paste Is Dead
description: Design rationale for disabled Paste menu item.
body: Paste is present and dead for two reasons: no Chromium engine will run execCommand('paste'), and navigator.clipboard.readText() is gated on a permission whose behaviour in a Tauri v2 WebView2 window could not be established without running the app. Shipping a Paste that silently does nothing is worse than one that says why. Full account in docs/design-notes/shell-chrome.md.
